root_cause_label: No coherent staircase-building algorithm; carryingBlock flag never synchronized with actual game state
one_sentence_failure_summary: Every solution rewrite lacked a systematic staircase-construction plan (requiring 7 intermediate block placements to reach gold at level 8), and the internal carryingBlock flag was never synchronized with the game's actual carrying state, causing every trial to run indefinitely without ever winning.
t_err_evidence: Step 8 writes solution.js with a carryingBlock boolean flag not synced to the game's actual u.carrying state, and with a stair-building strategy that can only drop one block at the current cell rather than constructing the 7 intermediate steps needed to reach gold at level 8; this is the first decisive algorithmic error.
t_commit_evidence: Step 9 runs node test_runner.js and it hangs immediately after 'DEBUG: invoking game.run(3)', printing nothing further; the trial never completes, locking in failure because every subsequent rewrite retained the same fundamental deficiency.
t_surface_evidence: Step 9 output: 'DEBUG: invoking game.run(3)' followed by 'The command has no new output after 10 seconds' -- the game run hangs indefinitely, the first observable failure signal.
trigger_explanation: The agent understood conceptually that it needed to build stairs (pick up blocks, drop them to build up height), but its generated code could only drop a block at the current cell without any mechanism to construct a sequential staircase of 7 height-1 steps. Additionally, the carryingBlock flag was tracked as an internal heuristic boolean that immediately diverged from the game's actual u.carrying state (set by c.pickup() and c.drop() internally), making block-management decisions incorrect from the start.
